question: Which hospital lie within 70 kilometers along the north axis from Smokestack Pottery, Fort Collins, CO?
sql:
WITH origin AS  (SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.071107 40.587891)',4326)::geography AS geometry)
SELECT * FROM pois, origin
WHERE ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-105.071107 40.587891)',4326)::geography, 70000)
AND amenity = 'hospital'
AND ((degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 0.0 AND 22.5) OR (degrees(ST_Azimuth(origin.geometry, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN 337.5 AND 360));
